title: The starter Secondary button frosts what is behind it like the mock glass
goal: The Secondary look of the Library Button is now a three quarters solid white surface, so over a busy screenshot the detail behind it shows through sharp, where the variants mock blurs what is behind its glass controls. Give a shape a way to blur what is under it and use it on the Secondary button so it reads as glass over anything.
notes: From the-starter-button-primary-shines-like-the-mock (2026-10-09). Secondary Background now has LayerStyle.opacity 0.74 (StarterComponents.glassOpacity) to match --glass rgba(255,255,255,.74); the renderer has no backdrop blur (BlurEffect blurs the layer itself). Needs a backdrop/background-blur effect in LayerEffects + DocumentRenderer, then add it to the Secondary look. Seen on Scripts/playtest/starter-button-shine-walk.json (dark artboard fixture), where over a soft backdrop it already reads like the mock; the gap shows over sharp content.
acceptance: A Secondary Button dropped over a screenshot shows what is behind it softened, as the mock glass does (button.css .btn.secondary, backdrop-filter)
Its words stay legible over any backdrop, in light and dark
Exported pictures look the same as the canvas
